生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for her consistent appearance.

Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided MOUNTAIN ROAD TO BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
for the geography and environment during Riven's approach.

Use the provided BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
for the settlement itself.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of the Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining sword is large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

No magical glow or energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Natural human movement and realistic running momentum.

Dynamic cinematic camera movement,
but keep the action visually clear and easy to follow.

Natural hair and cloth physics.

Dusk gradually transitioning into stronger orange firelight
as Riven approaches the settlement.

Natural footsteps, breathing, wind, fire,
distant shouting, and environmental sound.

English dialogue.

Natural lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat.

Keep the entire sequence simple and continuous.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven is already moving toward the distant burning settlement.

The video begins very close to her feet.

She suddenly accelerates into a full-speed sprint
along the mountain road.

After a short but intense run,
a foreground object wipes across the camera,
creating a natural travel transition.

After the transition,
Riven is much closer to the burning settlement.

Civilians and soldiers are running away from it.

Riven slows and asks a retreating soldier what happened.

He only tells her to run.

Everyone continues fleeing.

Riven looks toward the burning settlement.

Instead of following them,
she turns toward the fire and walks alone into the settlement.


=== SHOT 1 — RIVEN BREAKS INTO A FULL SPRINT ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY on an EXTREMELY LOW CLOSE TRACKING SHOT
beside Riven's boots on the mountain road.

Do not begin with a wide establishing shot.

Do not recreate the distant previous composition.

Do not show the cabin.

Riven is already moving quickly.

For the first brief moment,
the camera tracks closely beside her boots.

Then—

Riven suddenly pushes harder
and BREAKS INTO A FULL-POWER SPRINT.

Her stride becomes longer and faster.

Her boots strike the dry mountain trail with force.

Loose dust and tiny stones kick backward naturally.

The camera rapidly accelerates with her.

Raise the camera naturally from her legs
into a close three-quarter tracking view.

Riven is now running at maximum speed.

Her body leans slightly forward.

Her arms drive naturally with each stride.

Her breathing becomes stronger.

Her pale-blonde hair and clothing stream backward
from the speed of her movement.

The Broken Sword remains securely carried on her body.

She does not draw it.

Keep the camera close to Riven
while she races along the mountain road.

Use the MOUNTAIN ROAD TO BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
to establish the environment:

a dry rugged trail along the mountainside,
dark pine forest,
rocks and steep mountain terrain,
with the burning settlement farther ahead.

Do not stop for a wide landscape shot.

The environment should move rapidly behind Riven,
giving a strong sensation of speed.

Riven continues sprinting toward the fire.

As she races past a large tree trunk or dark rock
very close to the camera,

the foreground object sweeps completely across the lens
and briefly fills the entire frame.

Use this full-frame obstruction
as a natural TRAVEL WIPE.

Time and distance pass during this hidden transition.


=== SHOT 2 — PEOPLE ARE RUNNING THE OTHER WAY ===

EMERGE DIRECTLY FROM THE WIPE.

Maintain Riven's running momentum.

She is still sprinting forward,
but she is now MUCH CLOSER to the burning settlement.

Do not show the journey between these two locations.

The surroundings immediately communicate the change:

the forest is thinner,

smoke is heavier,

ash drifts through the air,

orange firelight flickers across the road,

and the sound of burning structures is much louder.

Riven continues running toward the settlement.

Suddenly—

ONE CIVILIAN runs past her
in the opposite direction.

Riven briefly glances toward them
but continues forward.

Then another civilian rushes past.

Then several more people emerge through the smoke.

They are all running AWAY
from the direction Riven is heading.

Several retreating soldiers appear among them.

Riven begins slowing from her sprint.

The camera stays with Riven
as the flow of fleeing people becomes clearer.

Through the smoke ahead,
reveal the entrance and burning buildings
of the settlement.

Riven slows almost to a stop.

A retreating soldier passes close beside her.

Riven turns toward him and asks:

"What happened?"

The soldier barely stops.

He looks back toward the burning settlement
and urgently answers:

"Just run!"

He immediately continues running away.

Do not explain what happened.

Do not reveal the mysterious figure.

Do not reveal any strange black markings.

Riven watches the soldier disappear
with the fleeing crowd.


=== SHOT 3 — RIVEN GOES THE OTHER WAY ===

Transition naturally into a frontal medium tracking shot.

Riven stands almost still for a brief moment.

Civilians and soldiers continue rushing past her.

The burning settlement is visible ahead through smoke and firelight.

Everyone around Riven is moving in ONE direction:

OUT OF THE SETTLEMENT.

Riven looks at the fleeing people.

Then she slowly turns her head
toward the burning settlement.

Hold briefly on her restrained expression.

She does not know what is waiting inside.

She does not draw the Broken Sword.

She does not prepare for combat.

Then Riven makes her decision.

She starts walking forward.

The camera moves backward in front of her.

Riven walks INTO the settlement.

At the same time,
civilians and soldiers continue running OUT
past both sides of her.

Create one strong visual contrast:

EVERYONE ELSE IS RUNNING OUT.

RIVEN ALONE IS WALKING IN.

Do not rush this moment.

Riven remains calm and focused
while frightened people move rapidly around her.

As she continues forward,
the crowd gradually becomes thinner.

The firelight grows stronger across her face.

Smoke becomes thicker.

The last few civilians and soldiers pass her.

Soon Riven is almost completely alone.

She continues deeper along the road
toward the burning buildings.

Smoke slowly obscures the path ahead.

Do not reveal the mysterious figure yet.

Do not begin combat.

Do not show a flashback.

Riven disappears deeper into the smoke and firelight.

CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has reached the burning settlement.

Everyone else is escaping.

Riven has chosen to enter.

She still carries only the remaining handle-side half
of her Broken Sword.

The sword remains dormant.

She has not yet discovered what caused the destruction.

CUT.、16:9

=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided RIVEN reference image for Riven.

Keep Riven consistent with the provided reference throughout the entire video.

There is only ONE Riven.

Do not use Riven's appearance for any other character.

Riven is holding her original large sword.

The sword is COMPLETELY INTACT throughout this entire scene.

The sword must NOT break.

Riven is completely REACTIVE in this scene.

Riven does NOT attack the Mystery Figure.

Riven does NOT charge forward.

Riven does NOT initiate combat.

She only sees the threat, becomes confused,
raises her sword defensively,
and is suddenly overwhelmed.


MYSTERY FIGURE:

Use the provided MYSTERY FIGURE reference image
as the visual identity of the mysterious attacker.

There is only ONE Mystery Figure.

Keep its overall mysterious dark form consistent with the reference.

However, throughout this scene,
the Mystery Figure must remain difficult to see clearly.

It is partially hidden by:

dense smoke,
darkness,
orange firelight,
